fields.statement: At 90d02941 ran go test -count=1 -run TestUmbrella -v ./internal/tui/roadmapapp: TestUmbrellaGroupIsOneRowUntilEnter passes. That last check is the --once path, which prints result() in cmd/rhiza/tui.go, and the commit leaves cmd/ untouched. Read the diff: umbrella rows are selectable, enter toggles before opening, and the cursor is kept across reloads. Also ran go test ./... (all ok), gofmt -l (clean) and go vet. make self-check passes with the session's RHIZA_* env unset.
